statement: Work is accepted systemically, not locally (owner list 2026-10-04, items 4, 7, 8 and item 1's steering text). Item 4: an approving verification of a quest whose change set touches src/ is an approval only with a record (note --verification ... --evidence <record.json>, embedded in the entry) that names at least one verification template whose id is a front-matter category of a file in docs/development/verification-templates (no retyped list), carries per named template its red-on-revert (reverted path in the quest's src/ change, what was reverted, the witness file - existing and in the change set or the quest's receipts - the behavioural assertion, and evidence by plain path or path:line that exists and names that assertion), carries every field the template's front-matter evidence list demands (whatChanged for retry-loops and sweep-timer), names every template whose trigger matches the change's added src/ lines, and carries a sample of the author's census and history pass or a locality proof with its census file; land refuses otherwise naming exactly what is missing, note refuses an unknown template id, and a quest touching no src/ path keeps today's behaviour. v1 enforced this through solver-verifier-verdict/1 (scripts/solve/verifier-verdict.js at 5271defb5^), lost in the v2 cutover. Item 7: the closure ledger gains mechanism classes MC-001..MC-004 (proxy signal, removal by key after an await, capture-then-wait, optimistic credit for work in flight) in the record form, and its --check-state audit holds them to the record checks plus definition, detection question and resolving commit, quest and path references; the design-note template and the quest guidance each point at the class list in one line. Item 8: AGENTS.md tells the receiver of a handoff that a claim naming no exact commit and suites is unproven. Item 1 (steering only): R04's body says a wait that reaches its bound is such a failure, logged with what was awaited and the last observed state, never an outcome or a normal exit. The always-loaded steering stays at 360 lines.

constraints.statement: No script, workflow or audit is added: the record check lives in the existing landing guard, the class check in the existing closure-ledger audit; the receipt is produced by the existing harness runtime from a scratch declaration; ratchets move one way only.
The admissible template ids, the fields a template demands and its trigger are read from the template files' front-matter; no code or test carries a second list of real template ids.

The guard checks every reference it mechanically can (template exists, reverted path in the src/ change, witness exists and is bound, evidence exists and names the assertion); what it cannot check - that the revert was run and reached the assertion through the intended path - is stated in the template INDEX and stays the independent verifier's to prove.
A quest whose change set touches no src/ path lands exactly as before; a rejection needs no record; REJECTION_STANDS and the staleness rule are unchanged.

The always-loaded steering stays at or below 360 lines: the AGENTS.md handoff line replaces tightened wording, and R04's body keeps its line count, id, slug and owner (the rule-set manifest binds those, not the body).
